_note: First-pass guesses for database entries that are written up but not drawn on any map. Positions are pixels on the named source map and come from the entry's own text (directions, neighbours, terrain) where it has any, otherwise they are spread across the region it belongs to. Every one is shown on the atlas as a guess until it is confirmed or moved in the viewer. Entries inside a city (wards, taverns, shops) are not placed; they appear in the city's card.
